title: Expressions
label: Expressions
checked: Results of mutate(), grouped mutate(), and grouped summarise() expressions on all five backends: arithmetic, comparison and logic with NA, conditionals, rounding, strings, offsets, ranks, cumulative functions, and aggregates.
description: tests/r/expr.R evaluates each expression with dplyr on a 7-row table and writes the results. The PHP tests evaluate the same expressions on the same table in each backend. Fixtures regenerated with the listed R versions on 2026-11-01; output byte-identical to the committed files.

comparison.applies_to: Column values; numbers rounded to 9 decimal places with PHP round() on both sides, Inf, -Inf, and NaN read as NA, and NA in identical positions
Polars column values; as above, with no fallback to a DataFrame

exclusions: round: not run on SQL databases. SQL ROUND does not round half to even; SqlTable evaluates round() in memory.
reproduce: PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL="pgsql:host=127.0.0.1;port=5432;dbname=postgres" PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL_USER=postgres PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL="mysql:host=127.0.0.1;port=3306" PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL_USER=root php vendor/bin/pest tests/ExprTest.php tests/SqlTest.php
